svg.aria-label: A quiet six-scene film loop through a homelab story: an imagined data center floor, its cold aisle, a rack of patch panels, the layer-1 cabling, the far end of a crossover, and the real bench in Toronto. Current conditions: day shift · load ▁▁▁▁▁ · 22°c toronto.

g.text: 01 · the floor — every homelab starts as a daydream of a facility

g.text: 02 · the cold aisle — still imaginary, but the physics is right
03 · the rack — t568a up top, t568b below, one dark fiber between
04 · layer 1 — everything above this line is an abstraction
04b · the far end — swap the orange and green pairs by hand: a crossover
05 · the bench — there is no facility. one hypervisor in toronto, carrying the whole dream
